_doc: The games the app lists, in order. blurb: the description on the game list; free: what the free version has.

games.title: The Kingdom of Frootopia
games.blurb: Join Cosmo and friends on a galaxy adventure, and save the Kingdom of Frootopia.

games.title: Noodle Rush
games.blurb: You're broke and starving. Talk your way to a free bowl of ramen.

games.title: Signal Decoders
games.blurb: Help Alex and Robin decode a mysterious alien signal in a blacked-out London.

games.title: Pirate Quest
games.blurb: Gather your crew, roll the dice and outwit rival captains on the hunt for the English fortune.

games.title: Leaning Tower of Pizza
games.blurb: Tell lies to grow Pinocchio's nose, and save Venice from the evil pizza robot.

games.title: Alien Customs
games.blurb: Convince a strict alien customs officer to let you into Jupiter with your suspicious luggage.

games.title: The Werewolf
games.blurb: Listen to the villagers and find out which of them is the werewolf, before it strikes again.
